name: AutomationDirect C0-08TR-3 digital output module
aliases: AutomationDirect C0-08TR-3 digital output module GA
summary: C0-08TR-3 digital output module arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: C0-08TR-3 is the drawing identifier for digital output module in AutomationDirect's CLICK PLCs collection. A digital output module sends discrete commands to connected control equipment. An output module is different from the power switching apparatus that may ultimately operate a motor.

For example, in a conveyor panel sending commands to interposing relays, use the C0-08TR-3 reference to coordinate output-terminal access, conductor routing and module replacement. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/CLICK/C0-08TR-3.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
readingNotes: Keep output-terminal access, conductor routing and module replacement visible in the layout.
